aka: Brazil: The Utopialand of Blaise Cendrars
this_title: Acaba de Chegar ao Brasil o Bello Poeta Francez Blaise Cendrars
trans_title: Brazil: The Utopialand of Blaise Cendrars
introduction: Part 1 – Blaise Cendrars’ journey to Brazil in 1924, his expeditions into the countryside, his encounters with the modernists, lectures, the attempt at a film, and the revolution in São Paulo.Part 2 – Pieces of his “Brazilian” works, as he claimed Brazil as “second spiritual homeland”: São Paulo poems, coffee, the Tiradentes werewolf, Aleijadinho, and South American women.
